correctness.rationale: Every claimed coefficient is a complete Boolean trace enumeration over 27 centers and all supports up to size four; five-point shattering is impossible because 32 traces exceed 27 distinct concepts. Two separate Python/C++17 integer-only checkers independently reproduce all face counts, facet orbit sizes and boundary ranks 26,325,1913, from which the exact mod-two Betti values 570,1489 follow. Six displayed representatives have verified orbit sizes. Finite computation is an exact certificate for this finite domain, not an infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: No inspected published statement covers the exact-distance-two relation on the full ternary three-cube together with its complete facet classification and mod-two homology. A binary exact-two theorem does not apply for alphabet size three; general ternary distance-one and inclusive one-ball results do not determine the traces of exact-distance-two spheres. Complete relevant primary RESULT.md files and two external primary papers were inspected. Lack of an exact match is not a guarantee of absolute historical priority.

value.rationale: The exact-radius-two Hamming relation on the smallest nontrivial three-coordinate ternary cube is canonical and is not determined by published radius-one or binary-radius-two theorems. Complete six-orbit facet classification and coexistence of 540 maximal triples with 3402 maximal tetrahedra, together with two nonzero homology degrees, reveal intrinsic structure beyond VC dimension. This is a naturally motivated complete finite classification and a benchmark for finite distance-shell concept systems, not an arbitrary small parameter recomputation.
